rounds.text: Bajaj Auto is currently trading at a significant premium, with a price-to-book ratio of 8.42x compared to a sector benchmark of 2.83x [E2, E7]. This valuation is further strained by a P/E ratio of 27.83x, which sits above the sector benchmark of 25.89x [E6]. Investors should be wary of the negative money flow, as foreign institutional holdings have declined by 5.36 percentage points since September 2023 [E43, E45, E70]. While the company reported strong profit growth, the cash conversion ratio of 0.25x in March 2026 indicates that reported profits are significantly outpacing actual operating cash flow [E34, E37]. Furthermore, the company faces operational headwinds, including raw material inflation, supply chain disruptions, and a recent ransomware attack that impaired product availability by up to 15% [E96, E97]. Conceded: the company maintains a strong return on equity of 29.2% and has demonstrated significant compounded sales growth of 37% over the trailing twelve months [E13, E17]. Despite these operational successes, the stock is currently priced at 96% of its 52-week range, suggesting that the market has already fully priced in the company's growth prospects [E49, E71].

evidence.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

evidence.fact: The company aims to introduce two new brands in the 125cc segment during the year.
evidence.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

evidence.fact: The management estimates that motorcycle category growth will slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
evidence.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

evidence.fact: The domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in Q1.
evidence.quote: The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance.

evidence.fact: The growth in the two-wheeler industry was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc motorcycle segment.
evidence.quote: This growth was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc segment of motorcycles.

evidence.fact: The 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish, leading to a 7% growth in the motorcycle industry.
evidence.quote: The 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish, resulting in a motorcycle growth in the industry of 7%.

evidence.fact: The company is expanding its capacity by nearly 25% to progressively reach 9 million units per annum from the current 7 million.
evidence.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

evidence.fact: The capacity expansion will primarily target EVs, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers.
evidence.quote: The key areas to address will be EVs, both two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles and three-wheelers.

evidence.fact: The company has almost 90 operational joint KTM-Triumph stores to expand reach.
evidence.quote: The rollout of the joint KTM-Triumph stores to expand reach while ensuring store viability is progressing steadily with now almost 90 outlets operational.

evidence.fact: EBITDA margins rose sequentially by 10 basis points to 20.9% despite a hyperinflationary commodity environment.
evidence.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

evidence.fact: Commodity inflation across the metals complex accelerated through May, impacting the quarter by about 4.5% of revenue.
evidence.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

evidence.fact: Year-on-year margins improved by 110 basis points, driven by favorable currency movements and improved operating leverage.
evidence.quote: On a year-on-year basis, margins improved by 110 basis points, primarily driven by favourable currency movements and improved operating leverage, which more than offset the adverse cost versus price dynamics.

evidence.fact: Capacity has emerged as a key constraint to the company's growth.
evidence.quote: Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth.

evidence.fact: The company's EV two-wheeler capacity is currently limited to 50,000 units.
evidence.quote: So, we are right now at 50,000 units. We are limited at that for EV two-wheelers.

evidence.fact: Sales of certain models in both domestic and international markets were restricted due to capacity issues.
evidence.quote: Capacity issues restricted sales of some models, both in India and overseas.

evidence.fact: The company generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow in the quarter, representing nearly 80% cash conversion of profit after tax.
evidence.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

evidence.fact: The company ended the June quarter with surplus cash exceeding INR 21,000 crores.
evidence.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

evidence.fact: The Board of Directors approved a payout of 100% of the profits made last year, split between a final dividend of INR150 per share and a buyback under the tender route at INR12,000 per share.
evidence.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

evidence.fact: The quarter was impacted by raw material inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions, and a ransomware attack.
evidence.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully.

evidence.fact: Supply chain issues and other disruptions reduced product availability by approximately 10% to 15%.
evidence.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

evidence.fact: Fuel availability became a major challenge early in the quarter due to the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.
evidence.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

evidence.fact: Management commitment: The company aims to complete its exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next six weeks.
evidence.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.
